newsitem.title: USA: Costco Cos unit to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: Costco Cos unit to redeem debentures.

text.p: Costco Cos Inc said Monday that its subsidiary, Costco Wholesale Corp, intends to redeem all of its 5-3/4 percent Convertible Subordinated Debentures due 2002.
The principal amount of debentures outstanding totaled $300 million, the company said.

The debentures will be redeemed on August 21, at a redemption price of $1,040.93 per $1,000 principal amount, which includes a redemption premium of $25.60 and accrued interest to August 21, of $15.33, the company said.

Prior to the close of business on August 14, the holders may convert the debentures into common stock of Costco Cos Inc at the conversion price of $41.25 per share, which equals about 24.24 shares of common stock per $1,000 principal amount of debentures.
The approximately $312.3 million required to complete the redemption, which includes the redemption premium and current accrued interest to August 21, will be financed with cash and/or borrowings.
